item.title: New AmnesiaStealer macOS malware hijacks browser sessions via remote control
item.description: Problem: Stealing static passwords is easy to defend against; getting live access to a victim's already logged-in accounts is harder. Approach: AmnesiaStealer clones a victim's Chromium browser profile, launches it hidden in headless mode, and connects to it over the browser's own remote-debugging interface, giving the attacker a live video feed and mouse/keyboard control. Result: Full interactive access to 16 Chromium-based browsers' cookies, saved logins, crypto wallets, keychain passwords, and Telegram sessions -- while still logged in. Why it matters: First documented macOS malware pairing profile cloning with live remote control, moving past theft into active session hijacking. Jargon: infostealer -- malware that harvests saved credentials/data. CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol) -- browser's built-in remote-debugging API. Headless browser -- one running with no visible window. ClickFix -- fake-verification trick that tricks users into running malicious scripts.

item.title: Strain flips Hall signal in altermagnetic manganese telluride, suggesting a path to practical spintronics
item.description: Problem: Altermagnets carry almost no net magnetization yet still break time-reversal symmetry -- but natural magnetic domains scramble that signal, making it hard to isolate or control. Approach: Rice University researchers stretched hexagonal manganese telluride along one axis to align its domains, then varied the strain while measuring the anomalous Hall effect, a sideways voltage produced by internal magnetic structure. Result: About 1% strain flipped the Hall signal's polarity entirely without disturbing the magnetic order -- an effect otherwise requiring a 150C temperature swing. Why it matters: A simple mechanical way to control altermagnetic behavior at room temperature, useful for strain-tunable spintronic sensors. Jargon: Altermagnet -- magnet with near-zero net moment but broken time-reversal symmetry. Anomalous Hall effect -- voltage from internal magnetism, not an external field. Strain -- mechanical stretching/deformation. Time-reversal symmetry -- physics law that a reversed-time system behaves identically; altermagnets break it.
